units.source_text: 《大树紧那罗经》云：“香山大树紧那罗于佛前弹琉璃琴，奏八万四千音乐。

en.t: The Sutra of the Great Tree Kinnara says: "The Great Tree Kinnara of Fragrant Mountain played a lapis lazuli lute before the Buddha and performed eighty-four thousand kinds of music.

units.source_text: 迦叶尊者忘威仪而起出。”

en.t: Venerable Kashyapa forgot his decorum, rose to his feet, and went out."

units.source_text: 迦叶尊者是释迦牟尼十大弟子之一。

en.t: Venerable Kashyapa was one of Shakyamuni's ten great disciples.
